<function name="UpdateBoneFollowers" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Updates positions of bone followers created by <page>Entity:CreateBoneFollowers</page>.

This should be called every tick.

<note>This function only works on `anim`, `nextbot` and `ai` type entities.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>

</function>
